description: This file is a header (.h) file that declares functions related to Radio MAC configuration within a wireless device library. It includes function prototypes for generating MAC addresses, updating base MAC addresses, and checking MAC shifted states, as well as inclusion of related type headers.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_shiftMbssIfNotEnoughVaps
methods.description: Attempts to shift the MBSS interface MAC address if there are not enough VAPs.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_updateRadBaseMac
methods.description: Updates the base MAC address of the radio.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateEpMac
methods.description: Generates an Ethernet MAC address for a given radio, interface name, and index, storing it in a provided MAC bin structure.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateBssid
methods.description: Generates a BSSID MAC address for a given radio, interface name, and index.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_generateDummyBssid
methods.description: Generates a dummy BSSID MAC address for testing or placeholder purposes.

methods.name: wld_rad_macCfg_hasShiftedMbssBaseMac
methods.description: Checks if the MBSS base MAC has been shifted.
